summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony by analysing the confidential supply-chain data drop, then building a product that detects contradictions between SAP/launch plan and documents and acts on them (emails, calls, routines) with a calm, phone-first UX.
summary.outcome: Found the real launch risks (overbooked art books, failed statue lot, game cards 6,800 short, sleeve revision conflict, false magnet alarm), and built a polling/versioned-store pipeline, routines engine, verifier shortfall fix, and a rebuilt 'Today' one-decision-at-a-time front end; most work is committed on jonas/alert-platform but not pushed.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no webhooks. Files are replaced under the same name without notice, so change detection must compare SHA-256 checksums by polling.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ (raw, drops, notes, design, state). .env holds SOONY_PORTAL_TOKEN and is gitignored; .env.example is committed.
Team workflow is defined in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md. Agents claim tasks with a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md.

Verifier shortfall (verifier/impact/shortfall.py) now computes gap = needed − usable − arriving. Inbound counts only if the ETA is before launch, it is not cancelled, has no matching goods receipt, is not overdue, and the supplier shipping document confirms it. Unread documents are not counted.
The image recognizer put the part number in the `item` field rather than `material_id`, so short shipments were not linked. A part-number fallback was added when mapping doc lines.

Routines engine supports four triggers (decisions, waiting, replies, shipments), steps (chase, call, ask_status, notify), three trust modes (ask/tell/quiet), undo, and a 'would handle' dry run. Calls are not dialled in dry_run.

Today UI (web/src/components/Today.tsx, TopBar.tsx, lib/today.ts) replaced the dense dashboard. Timeline, full list and routines moved to /plan, /suppliers and routines. FlowGraph.tsx was restyled into When/Then/Always lanes for the wide view.

code.finding: Wide routine diagram rewritten into When/Then/Always lanes that wrap. The narrow vertical view is unchanged. Committed as b55bb8a.
Parts now carry `arriving` and `not_counted` lists. Hwaseong's 20,000 balance arriving 24 Nov is never counted, giving 6,800 short once the shipping advice is read.
The allocate card's paper-check line, question and approver message use stock plus arriving.

workflow: Subagents work well for parallel jobs (cross-checking 200 order confirmations and 59 scans, backend routines, designer, front-end rebuild, verifier fix). Give each one disjoint files to avoid edit collisions.
Check the live state read-only after a rebuild. A live screenshot showed the Standard stop time was still attributed to the wrong card, which a mocked run would not have shown.
Ask the user before paid API calls (the one OpenAI image-recognizer run was approved) and before real outward actions such as supplier emails.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change, so read-only sessions show no checkpoint even though the hooks fired.
Tell the user plainly when a screenshot is of mock or illustrative data.
